prior_year_events.event_name: Two large incurred claims and higher than expected attritional claims
prior_year_events.impact_description: 2013 year of account suffered a deterioration of GBP 2.1m in respect of two large incurred claims during the year and a generally higher than expected increase in attritional claims.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves at 1 January 2014 were GBP 85.354m. During 2014 there was a small net favourable run-off on prior years of GBP 1.274m (a release), driven by mixed development across the motor book: favourable development in third party liability motor partially offset by adverse development in other motor classes and a small adverse movement on reinsurance inwards. The prior year movements reflect a combination of adverse attritional trends and the impact of large incurred claims in earlier years.
